open_points.subject: A05 phase 7 cycle failure reporting
open_points.text: "7. cycles: the graph of nodes and edges is acyclic;" together with "the first check that fails is the result, with its phase, its node or edge and its reason"
open_points.question: If multiple cycles exist, which specific node/edge must be reported as the single first failure?
options: report a generic cycle failure with no node/edge
report the first cycle found by traversal
report the smallest edge/node by the global ordering
open_points.default_guess: report the smallest edge in cycle-detection order by the same Unicode ordering used elsewhere

open_points.subject: A05 phase 9 reach failure reporting
open_points.text: "9. reach: at least one output of every function node reaches..."
open_points.question: When more than one function node violates reach, which one is the "first failure" for M17?
options: function nodes checked by node_id order
graph traversal order from flow outputs backward
open_points.default_guess: check function nodes by node_id order and report the first failing one

open_points.subject: A05 rule 7 composition pre-proof duplicate reporting
open_points.text: "Composition refuses... whose node ids repeat... the first of these, in this order, is named"
open_points.question: Inside one duplicate category (e.g., repeated node_id or repeated flow input name), which duplicate instance/name must be named as the refusal reason?
options: only category-level reason without offending identifier
open_points.default_guess: name the smallest offending identifier by Unicode order

open_points.subject: A10 rule 7 request_digest header scope
open_points.text: "every header the kernel sends, names lower-cased and in code-point order, each with its value"
open_points.question: Does request_digest include only headers explicitly constructed by kernel rules, or also transport/client auto-added headers (e.g., Host, Content-Length, User-Agent)?
options: include only rule-defined headers (required + credential + deterministic content headers)
include full final wire headers after HTTP client mutation
include a fixed whitelist documented by kernel
open_points.default_guess: include only deterministic rule-defined headers, excluding transport auto-added headers

open_points.subject: A10/A11 approval-use state on crash after send
open_points.text: A11 rule 1: "A crash between those two calls is the in_flight case of rule 4, whose recovery also marks that approval used." and A11 rule 4 only states converting in_flight to unknown and writing NodeExecution when missing
open_points.question: At restart recovery, is approval status transition to `used` mandatory for every recovered `in_flight` attempt, and in which store call ordering relative to writing `outcome_unknown`?
options: mark approval used in the same recovery transaction that sets attempt unknown
mark approval used in a separate follow-up transaction
open_points.default_guess: mark approval used atomically with setting EffectAttempt to unknown and writing any missing NodeExecution
